newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Shing soars after COSCO cash offer.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing soars after COSCO cash offer.

text.p: Shares of Shun Shing Holdings Ltd soared on Friday morning on buying fuelled by asset injection hopes after COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd made a general offer for Shun Shing shares.
"Expectation of asset injection into the company by COSCO fuelled strong short-term buying interest on the shares," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
Shun Shing shares soared HK$0.86 to HK$1.85 in early trade after they hit a high of HK$2.075 shortly after the market opened. Volume was 43.03 million shares.
Brokers said many expected COSCO to inject property interest into the company, brightening its future earnings.
COSCO (Hong Kong) Group's unit COSCO (H.K.) Property Development Ltd said it would make a HK$0.72 per share cash offer for Shun Shing after raising its stake to 61 percent from 30 percent.
COSCO (Hong Kong) is the holding company of container leasing group COSCO Pacific Ltd.
